system.description:
Range 60ft cone, 1 minute per level (concentration). Each round you focus on one creature in the cone and read its surface thoughts; Will negates for that creature (it knows nothing has been read). Stone 3ft thick, lead or metal sheets block it. Cast reversed (Obscure Thoughts), one touched creature is immune to thought detection for the same duration.

Reversible: may be cast as its opposite with the same slot.

Classes: Wizard, Illusionist, Warlock, Bard, Necromancer, Witch
